method_name: Bayesian black-hole superradiance constraints on ULBs
non_negotiable_steps: Use full (M, a*) posterior samples; do not collapse to point estimate
Apply SR condition omega_R < m Omega_H per (n,l,m)
Require tau_SR < tau_BH/N_efolds for spin-down to actually occur
Combine multiple low-l modes (l=m=1,2,3) in the final exclusion union
Treat self-interactions via Bosenova: SR is allowed only if N_extract < N_bosenova
Exclusion probability = posterior fraction with the above conditions met
Quote 95% and 68% credible exclusion intervals on mu and lower bound on f_a
deviations_from_named_method: We use the analytic Detweiler/Arvanitaki small-alpha rate rather than the full numerical Dolan-Detweiler hydrogenic spectrum. This is the standard literature approximation for alpha <~ 0.5 and is conservative.
Bosenova threshold uses the leading c_n n^4 / alpha^3 scaling with c_n=5 (paper_000 Eq. 40). The exact O(1) prefactor introduces ~0.5 dex uncertainty on the f_a lower bound.
